chunks: Whoever performs fifty hajj (pilgrimages), a city will be built for him in Jannat 'Adn. In it are a thousand palaces; in every palace are a thousand hūrā' from the hūr al-'īn and a thousand spouses, and he will be made among the companions of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله in Paradise.

key_terms.جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ: the Garden of Eden, a lofty station in Paradise
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ: fifty, indicating the number of pilgrimages

ai.seo_question: What reward is mentioned for someone who performs fifty hajj pilgrimages?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense reward in the hereafter for one who performs fifty hajj pilgrimages. It portrays a magnificent abode in Jannat 'Adn and the honor of companionship with Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله in Paradise.
